description: Release this Session's Claim on a Goal, leaving it paused for a later Session. With to, hand it over in this one call instead: another chat's Session ID (get_status lists the chats in this project), which then holds it, or 'next' for the next chat whose get_status takes it.

goal.description: The claimed Goal's ID, such as 'ship-oauth-login'. Needed only when this Session holds several Goals.

to.description: Hand the Goal to this chat instead of pausing it: a running Session's ID such as 's-1a2b3c', or 'next'.

name: release_goal
title: Release Goal
